messages:
kari-newhire: Hi team :wave: a few onboarding benefits/payroll Qs from week 1 — 1) My carrier email says medical starts 10/01 but my offer and Workday show 09/16 (my start). Which is accurate? 2) I paid for a child's immunization on 09/18 (receipt attached) 1 can that be reimbursed if carrier backdates? 3) I opted into pre-tax parking but my paycheck still shows the deduction 1 will that be prorated for a mid-month start?

vivian-peopleops: Welcome @kari-newhire! Short answers: (1) Carriers often default to the 1st of the month after enrollment if the enrollment hit their cutover. DM your enrollment timestamp and well escalate to benefits. (2) If the carrier approves a retro effective date you should file the claim in the carrier portal; if denied we can do a one-time manual reimbursement (expense code "benefits-one-time") with receipt + carrier denial. (3) Pre-tax parking follows payroll schedule; mid-month elections are prorated if changed before payroll cutoff. I'll open BEN-6333 to confirm your effective date and PARK-128 for parking proration.

payroll-bot: Automated: Payroll cutoff is T-7 days before pay date. Elections made after cutoff apply next pay run. Delta payroll requests for proration can be submitted here: https://payroll.redwood.internal/delta. Manual adjustments may appear as Other Compensation and take 1-2 pay cycles.

benefits-team: BEN-6333 created, requesting carrier confirmation for retroactive effective date to 09/16. Expect reply 48-72 hrs. If carrier responds yes, we'll post instructions for claim submission.

commuter-bot: PARK-128 opened with vendor. If parking deduction wrong, vendor refunds typically processed within 2 cycles. Please DM last 4 of emp ID to expedite.

kari-newhire: Thanks all 1 sent DM with enrollment timestamp and emp ID, uploaded immunization receipt. Appreciate the fast replies :thumbsup:
